:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--resource_name`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name of the resource to be loaded and use for ligand-receptor inference.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"consensus"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"baccin2019"`, `"cellcall"`, `"cellchatdb"`, `"cellinker"`, `"cellphonedb"`, `"celltalkdb"`, `"connectomedb2020"`, `"consensus"`, `"embrace"`, `"guide2pharma"`, `"hpmr"`, `"icellnet"`, `"italk"`, `"kirouac2010"`, `"lrdb"`, `"mouseconsensus"`, `"ramilowski2015"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gene_symbol`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Column name in var DataFrame in which gene symbol are stored.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"gene_symbol"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--expr_prop`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum expression proportion for the ligands/receptors (and their subunits) in the corresponding cell identities. Set to '0', to return unfiltered results.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_cells`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum cells per cell identity ('groupby') to be considered for downstream analysis.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `5`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--aggregate_method`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Method aggregation approach, one of ['mean', 'rra'], where 'mean' represents the mean rank, while 'rra' is the RobustRankAggregate (Kolde et al., 2014) of the interactions.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"rra"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"mean"`, `"rra"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_opts`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Strategies to aggregate interactions across methods. Default is None - i.e. ['Specificity', 'Magnitude'] and both specificity and magnitude are aggregated.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--return_all_lrs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Bool whether to return all LRs, or only those that surpass the 'expr_prop' threshold. Those interactions that do not pass the 'expr_prop' threshold will be assigned to the *worst* score of the ones that do. 'False' by default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_perms`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of permutations for the permutation test. Note that this is relevant only for permutation-based methods - e.g. 'CellPhoneDB
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `100`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/interpret/lianapy/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/interpret/lianapy);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/interpret/lianapy/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
